apps.gateway.it_has_to_be: it has to be bought first
apps.gateway.parts_in_the_new: {0} parts in the new machine // {1} left behind go to stock, with the old case and board
apps.gateway.drive_bays_security_slots: {0} drive bays // {1} security slots // {2} min to migrate
apps.infoText.you_are_a_on: You are a {0} on a Windows-style desktop. A broker hands you jobs. For each one you find the target machine, route your connection through relays, break in, do the work, wipe your tracks and get paid.
apps.infoText.every_action_leaves_a: Every action leaves a log somewhere, and logs are what get people caught. While you are connected the target {0} you back along your route. If the trace reaches you, or the {1} from the evidence you leave behind reaches 100, the run is over.
apps.infoText.on_dsnet_in_internet: {0} on DSNET in Internet XPlorer (or from a mail in Outlook).
apps.infoText.on_the_nexus_map: {0} on the Nexus Map in Bl@ckG@te and plan a route of relay hops.
apps.infoText.link_then_open_its: {0} (LINK), then open its locks, bypass its defences and do the work.
apps.infoText.delete_or_scrub_the: {0}: delete or scrub the logs your visit left, and disconnect before the trace finishes.
apps.infoText.in_my_jobs_on: {0} in MY JOBS on DSNET to be paid and gain rating.
apps.infoText.your_machine_device_manage: {0} your machine (Device Manager, eForest) and your tools (App Store) to take harder, better paid work.
apps.infoText.new_here_follow_the: New here? Follow the {0} in the bottom-right corner. It lights up what to click, and it ends with a practice server you cannot lose to.
apps.infoText.use_the_list_on: Use the list on the left to read about every window. The search box above it looks through all the topics.
apps.infoText.the_machine_boots_and: The machine boots and types out its start-up log. The login screen lists up to {0}. Pick one to carry on its run, or choose {1} and type a handle.
apps.infoText.a_profile_has_one: A profile has one save. Starting a new session under a handle that already has a save replaces it (the login screen warns you in red first).
apps.infoText.with_four_profiles_in: With four profiles in use a new handle is refused: {0} one first (press it twice to confirm).
apps.infoText.the_switch_starts_today: The {0} switch starts today's world: the same for everybody, with a modifier.
apps.infoText.your_world_is_made: YOUR WORLD IS MADE FOR YOU
apps.infoText.a_new_profile_gets: A new profile gets its own random world, built from a seed. A setup screen shows it being made: the {0} (name, site, industry, city), then the {1} (about 900 staff and 1,100 civilians, each with a full dossier and a portrait). Click or press any key to speed it up. Most of these people will never matter, but any of them could be a way in.
apps.infoText.the_game_saves_by: The game saves by itself every 45 seconds (you can switch this off in Control Panel > Settings). {0} saves at once, and {1} (or the Start menu's {2}) saves and goes back to the login screen. If a save fails a message says so.
apps.infoText.the_start_button_bottom: The Start button (bottom left) lists every application and has {0} and {1} buttons. Clicking elsewhere or pressing {2} closes it.
apps.infoText.a_new_run_starts: A new run starts with an {0}: no software at all, and 3,000 cr on top of the usual 4,000, which is the price of the four basic tools. A {1} sits in the bottom-right corner and walks you through a fixed script, lighting up the thing to click.
apps.infoText.open_the_and_install: Open the {0} and install the four basic tools, one at a time, each with what it is for:
apps.infoText.wipes_the_logs_your: {0}: wipes the logs your visit leaves.
apps.infoText.you_finish_this_part: You finish this part with exactly 4,000 cr.
apps.infoText.they_run_on_one: They run on one {0} (practice-rig, 10.9.9.9) that exists only for the tutorial and is destroyed when it ends. It has no guards and no locks and nothing is a job. The lessons follow what you really do:
apps.infoText.copy_a_file_from: Copy a file from the server
apps.infoText.delete_the_server_s: Delete the server's log files and disconnect
apps.infoText.delete_a_file_from: Delete a file from your own storage in My Computer
apps.infoText.the_card_has_a: The card has a progress bar and three small buttons: {0} it away to a thin tab, move it to the {1} of the screen, or let it {2} the window it is talking about. It can be tucked or moved but not ended. The Command Prompt command cheat tutorial (or SKIP THE TUTORIAL on the Debug menu's SWITCHES tab) skips the rest: the basic software and the lessons' 2,100 cr are yours at once and the practice server is destroyed.
apps.infoText.running_costs_start_once: Running costs start once the tutorial is done: every game day you pay 60 cr plus 2% of what your rig is worth.
apps.infoText.your_handle_and_rank: {0}: your handle and rank, credits, rating, the heat bar, the world clock and the speed, pause and ACTIVE buttons. The BLACKGATE logo at the left opens the Debug menu.
apps.infoText.one_icon_per_application: {0}: one icon per application. Double-click an icon to open it.
apps.infoText.the_start_button_and: {0}: the Start button and a button for every open window. Click a button to bring its window forward or to restore it when minimised.
apps.infoText.drag_a_window_by: Drag a window by its {0} to move it. You can drag it mostly off screen: {1} always stay visible so you can grab it back.
apps.infoText.drag_the_to_resize: Drag the {0} to resize. Each app has a smallest size.
apps.infoText.the_title_bar_buttons: The title-bar buttons {0}, {1} and {2}. Closing a window does not lose your place in the game.
apps.infoText.clicking_anywhere_in_a: Clicking anywhere in a window brings it to the front.
apps.infoText.hover_almost_anything_for: Hover almost anything for a moment (about a third of a second) for a {0}. Text that is cut short shows its whole text too.
apps.infoText.cycles_the_world_clock: Cycles the world-clock speed. Time passes faster, and so do traces, deadlines and cooling.
apps.infoText.stops_or_restarts_the: Stops or restarts the world clock. Same as Space.
apps.infoText.opens_my_jobs_the: Opens MY JOBS: the work you hold.
apps.infoText.open_the_command_prompt: Open the Command Prompt with the cursor in it
apps.infoText.pause_or_resume_the: Pause or resume the world clock
apps.infoText.leave_a_text_field: Leave a text field, or close the Start menu or an open dropdown
apps.infoText.press_the_highlighted_butt: Press the highlighted button / run a Command Prompt line
apps.infoText.full_screen_on_and: Full screen on and off (the Windows app starts full screen)
apps.infoText.turn_the_machine_back: Turn the machine back on after Turn off
apps.infoText.the_backtick_and_space: The backtick and Space only act while a run is on and you are {0} in a field.
apps.infoText.zoom_in_and_out: Zoom in and out around the pointer (1x to 8x)
apps.infoText.highlights_it_and_the: Highlights it and the other cities of its country, and lists the machines found there
apps.infoText.pick_a_machine_in: Pick a machine in the list
apps.infoText.the_map_glides_to: The map glides to it and zooms in
apps.infoText.the_arrow_keys_and: The arrow keys, {0} and {1} move the caret, a click puts it where you click, and typing, Backspace, Delete and paste work at the caret.
apps.infoText.events_have_sounds_a: Events have sounds (a link opening, a lock breaking, a trace warning, a payout) and the screen has faint effects: scanlines, a red edge pulse as a trace nears, a glitch when something goes wrong and a shake on a raid. Control Panel > Settings turns {0} and {1} off separately.
apps.infoText.jobs_what_you_are: Jobs: what you are asked to do
apps.infoText.jobs_come_from_clients: Jobs come from clients through the broker. Each has a target machine, an objective, a payout and a deadline. Details your brief needs (a file name, a person, an amount) are marked and highlighted in the text.
apps.infoText.copy_a_file_off: Copy a file off the host and bring it home to your storage.
apps.infoText.erase_one_file_from: Erase one file from the host.
apps.infoText.wipe_the_host_every: Wipe the host: every file and every log.
apps.infoText.rewrite_one_detail_in: Rewrite one detail in a person's record on a host that keeps it.
apps.infoText.move_funds_out_of: Move funds out of an account on a bank host.
apps.infoText.steal_a_trained_ai: Steal a trained AI model off an AI lab's host.
apps.infoText.missions_that_are_part: Missions that are part of the story.
apps.infoText.a_job_pays_its: A job pays its kind's base plus a share for the host's guards, multiplied by 1 + rating / 100. By rating 100 the same job pays double.
apps.infoText.the_board_keeps_6: The board keeps 6 open offers, one more for every 30 rating, up to 10.
apps.infoText.harder_hosts_only_appear: Harder hosts only appear as your rating grows. Guards the tool versions your rating has unlocked cannot beat are never offered.
apps.infoText.miss_a_deadline_and: Miss a deadline and the job fails.
apps.infoText.in_internet_xplorer_is: {0} in Internet XPlorer is the main market. See the next topic.
apps.infoText.sometimes_carries_a_job: {0} sometimes carries a job offer with ACCEPT / DECLINE / SHOW TARGET and an OPEN LINK button to the deal page.
apps.infoText.in_the_header_opens: {0} in the header opens MY JOBS with everything you hold.
apps.infoText.when_the_objective_is: When the objective is done the job becomes {0}. Press {1} in MY JOBS. The fee goes to your account and your rating rises. A job is only complete when you submit it, so do it before the deadline.
apps.infoText.internet_xplorer_is_the: Internet XPlorer is the desktop browser and the only window open when a new run starts. It has up to {0} (each closes with its own x, the last stays open), back, forward, reload, home, one bar for addresses and searches and a three-relay circuit (click it to route through new relays).
apps.infoText.the_address_bar_opens: The address bar opens a known address, goes to a dsn:// address you typed (a 404 if nothing lives there) and searches DSNET for anything else, so a company, a broker or a word works too. Home and new tabs open the {0}, with a tile for each site.
apps.infoText.the_social_network_faces: The social network: faces, photos, and the public details of everyone.
apps.infoText.the_domain_registry_type: The domain registry: type a company or domain for a WHOIS record beside what the game knows.
apps.infoText.the_hardware_store_see: The hardware store. See its own topic.
apps.infoText.the_portal_search_the: The portal: search, the six categories, the biggest fees, the brokers
apps.infoText.data_heists_scrubbers_pape: DATA HEISTS, SCRUBBERS, PAPERWORK, MONEY MOVES, BURN BOOK, MIND THEFT
apps.infoText.a_client_s_own: A client's own site: banner, tagline, listings and an about page
apps.infoText.a_listing_brief_and: A listing: brief and target on the left, the deal and the client channel on the right
apps.infoText.my_jobs_submit_link: MY JOBS: SUBMIT, LINK NOW, SHOW ON MAP, DROP (asks twice), deals waiting on a reply, your history
apps.infoText.leakbase_what_is_known: LEAKBASE: what is known about a company, its hosts and its staff
apps.infoText.the_undernet_board_rumours: The undernet board: rumours that change every day
apps.infoText.on_dsnet_pages_a: On DSNET pages a {0} on the left lists HUB, MY JOBS, the six categories with counts, the brokers and the board. The menu button folds it to icons. The hub shows open listings, your jobs, replies waiting and the best fee, then a search, a chip for each category and the listings, which you can order by {1}, {2} or {3}. Each card shows the fee, the time left as a bar, the difficulty as pips and the broker, with VIEW and ACCEPT.
apps.infoText.on_a_listing_you: On a listing you may ask for +10%, +25%, +50% or an exact amount. The client answers a few game minutes later:
apps.infoText.the_fee_rises_to: {0}: the fee rises to your ask.
apps.infoText.halfway_between_the_posted: {0}: halfway between the posted fee and your ask. {1} it, or {2} once with an amount between (a second round is harder and ends in yes or no).
apps.infoText.ask_for_more_than: {0}: ask for more than double and the listing is pulled, and that client will not deal with you for a game day.
apps.infoText.the_chance_of_a: The chance of a yes is shown on each button. It grows with your rating and shrinks with how much you ask and how stubborn the client is. You get one ask per job, and the same ask on the same job always gets the same answer. {0} (press twice) walks away at any point. The talk is shown as a chat console with a status line ("... is typing", "counter-offer on the table", "channel closed").
apps.infoText.posts_from_random_people: {0}: posts from random people, a new set every time the page loads. Click a name to open a profile.
apps.infoText.search_everyone_by_name: {0}: search everyone by name, job, company or city, fifty to a page.
apps.infoText.portrait_job_an_about: {0}: portrait, job, an About box (works at, lives in, handle, email, phone) and recent posts. Public details are links that go into the dossier when clicked; private ones read "private". {1} puts the person on file and opens Dossiers.
apps.infoText.each_of_the_40: Each of the 40 companies has a site (www.<name>.nx) in one of ten themes. The home page shows the company; /team lists every staffer with public email and phone as clickable links; /contact gives reception's details. Clicking a public detail adds it to the person's dossier.
apps.infoText.bl_ckg_te_has: Bl@ckG@te has four tabs: {0}, {1}, {2} and {3}. It opens on the map, or on the link when one is open.
apps.infoText.the_world_map_with: The world map with every machine you have discovered. A search box and a {0} dropdown (All, Relay, Public, Bank, Gov, Favourite...) filter the pins. Beside the map are three tabs:
apps.infoText.the_list_with_and: {0}: the list, with {1} / {2} and {3} on every row and the picked host's card.
apps.infoText.your_hops_as_a: {0}: your hops as a chain from your gateway to the target, each with UP, DOWN, SHOW and REMOVE. A hop is green while your gateway hides it cleanly and red when it slows the link.
apps.infoText.routes_you_kept_with: {0}: routes you kept, with USE and DELETE.
apps.infoText.and_anywhere_in_the: {0} and {1} (anywhere in the game) select the host on the map and in the list, and the map glides to it. Mark hosts you like as favourites.
apps.infoText.add_relay_hops_to: Add relay hops to your bounce route. Every hop slows the trace that follows you back, so more hops buy you time. How many hops stay clean is set by your internet cards (see Device Manager); a route may take 8 hops, or as many as your cards carry when that is more. Save a good route to reuse it.
apps.infoText.press_to_connect_through: Press {0} to connect through your route. Opening the link starts the host's clock: from now on it traces you.
apps.infoText.the_last_host_of: The last host of a company is its crown jewel and an {0}: the map marks it INTERNAL and it cannot be linked from outside. Link to another host of the company and move inside with the Network Mapper and the Staff Pass Forger (see the App Store topic). The Company Map tab shows the segments you know of with a FORGE button on each.
apps.infoText.with_a_link_open: With a link open, the Live Link tab shows the target. Its tabs are {0}, {1}, {2}, {3} and {4}.
apps.infoText.right_click_is_the: RIGHT-CLICK IS THE WAY TO ACT
apps.infoText.the_link_has_no: The link has no side panel: services, files and logs use the full width and every action is a {0} on its target.
apps.infoText.a_copy_to_my: A {0}: Copy to my computer, Delete the file and (when encrypted) Decrypt.
apps.infoText.a_crack_the_password: A {0}: Crack the password, Hijack the session, or the voice steps, with the lock's version beside yours.
apps.infoText.a_delete_all_logs: A {0}: Delete all logs, or Scrub my own logs.
apps.infoText.the_in_the_header: The {0} in the header: the bypasses (firewall, monitor, proxy), DDoS, the network tools and the log wipes.
apps.infoText.only_the_apps_you: Only the apps you have installed are listed. One that cannot run now is greyed with the reason. Running tasks have their own draggable window.
apps.infoText.the_services_and_their: The services and their locks, the host's trait and the actions. The guards (FW / MON / PX), difficulty and window are only shown once you own the Target Overview.
apps.infoText.a_small_file_explorer: A small file explorer of the host: its files and logs. Click NAME to sort A-Z or Z-A.
apps.infoText.the_people_whose_details: The people whose details the host keeps, with search and portraits. Alteration jobs are done here.
apps.infoText.the_company_s_staff: The company's staff, with the OSINT attacks (see People and OSINT).
apps.infoText.a_shell_over_the: A shell over the host and your gateway. See below.
apps.infoText.firewall_breaker_of_the: Firewall Breaker of the same level or more, or the DDoS cannon
apps.infoText.raises_the_alarm_when: Raises the alarm when you make noise
apps.infoText.alarm_silencer_of_the: Alarm Silencer of the same level or more
apps.infoText.hides_the_real_host: Hides the real host and scrambles the route
apps.infoText.relay_cleaner_of_the: Relay Cleaner of the same level or more, or the DDoS cannon
apps.infoText.the_overload_attack_drops: The {0} (Overload Attack) drops the firewall and the proxy at once, but it starts the trace immediately and three times as fast.
apps.infoText.are_opened_by_the: {0} are opened by the Password Breaker. A bigger lock needs a higher version.
apps.infoText.from_difficulty_4_a: {0}: from difficulty 4 a back-end lock sits behind app MFA, from 7 session-bound MFA and from 9 a hardware token. A cracked password is not enough: the Two-Step Login Bypass {1} a live session (v1 beats app MFA, v2 session-bound). The captured token lasts {2}; when it runs out the service locks again and an alteration under way is lost.
apps.infoText.want_the_security_key: {0} want the Security Key Reader fitted in your machine; with it the lock is cracked like a password.
apps.infoText.open_to_their_admin: {0} open to their admin's voice: profile the admin for their phone, record them (RECORD, or a call from PEOPLE) and then VOICEPRINT. This needs the Voice Copier.
apps.infoText.need_the_file_unlocker: {0} need the File Unlocker of at least the file's encryption level (up to 7).
apps.infoText.every_running_task_takes: Every running task takes one {0}. Cracking, decrypting and voice work take two. Any number of tasks can be started (the queue holds eight) but only as many as your slots allow are processing; the rest show WAITING and start in order as slots free up. A task that does not fit waits while a lighter one behind it may run.
apps.infoText.a_copy_takes_the: A copy takes the file's size over your uplink (1.2 GB a second for every Gbps). A host whose firewall, monitor and proxy add up to 6 or more drops your session on its own clock: 90 seconds at 6, 15 fewer for each step, never under 45. A timeout is not a capture: copies under way are lost and the logs you left still count.
apps.infoText.a_shell_over_the_2: A shell over the host (/: files, logs) and your gateway (~: apps, downloads, logs). Commands: cd, ls [-l] [-a], cat, del, copy, decrypt, crack, hijack, bypass fw|mon|proxy, ddos, mapnet, probe, escalate, wipe, scrub, burn, and the hacker tools nmap, ps, top, trace, netstat, traceroute, ping, hexdump, strings, file, df, ifconfig, uname, id, sysinfo. help lists them and help <command> explains one. Tab completes and Up / Down recall. Control Panel > Settings can open every link on the CLI tab.
apps.infoText.while_you_are_connected: While you are connected the target traces you back along your bounce route. More hops slow it down. A warning appears when it is getting close (a Trace Alert tool makes it come earlier). If the trace completes the connection is seized and {0}. Disconnect in time.
apps.infoText.past_two_thirds_the: Past two thirds the trace speeds up.
apps.infoText.a_link_that_keeps: A link that keeps making noise gets the admin's attention: a warning, then the trace doubles (a blinded monitor prevents it).
apps.infoText.drops_every_task_and: {0} drops every task and slows the trace for 10 seconds at a cost of heat, once per link.
apps.infoText.disconnecting_with_the_tra: Disconnecting with the trace at {0} pays a close-call bonus (once per host).
apps.infoText.hard_hosts_carry_a: Hard hosts carry a trait (honeypot, night shift, paranoid) shown under the link header.
apps.infoText.the_rented_overseas_server: The Rented Overseas Server is the one exception: if its trace completes, the provider pulls the plug and {0}, but the run goes on.
apps.infoText.every_link_writes_a: Every link writes a {0} log with your address on the target and on each bounce hop, and your actions add more on the target. A machine keeps its logs until you scrub or wipe them. {1} deletes them all; {2} quietly removes only yours (needs the Quiet Log Cleaner).
apps.infoText.logs_you_leave_behind: Logs you leave behind become {0} when you disconnect: 2 each on the target, 1.1 each on a hop. Delete or modify them before you leave.
apps.infoText.heat_runs_from_0: Heat runs from 0 to 100 and cools down over game time, including while the clock runs faster. The header shows the bar and the band: {0} below 70, {1} at 70 and up (unmarked vehicles near the hideout) and {2} at 100.
apps.infoText.at_heat_100_you: At heat 100 you are raided. Security parts can save you: a security part's own failsafe triggers first, then the shield, and last the chassis purge. Without protection the raid ends the run. With the {0} fitted, BREACH is a 15-second real-time countdown (the clock is forced to 1x) before the raid lands; without them there is no warning.
apps.infoText.the_adds_45_seconds: The {0} adds 45 seconds to the countdown, but for the next 6 game hours every link leaves twice the heat.
apps.infoText.the_burns_the_rig: The {0} burns the rig when the raid lands: the warrant is void and you start again on the Micro PC, with credits, tools and stock kept and the drives empty.
apps.infoText.the_can_drive_to: The {0} can drive to a new grid from a RECON investigation (heat 70 or more, no link open): heat drops to 0, the rig is on the road for 2 hours, once a day (gw relocate or the RELOCATE button).
apps.infoText.the_micro_pc_has: The Micro PC has no room for security parts, but a surge protector absorbs 15% of a raid. The GHOST-VPS cannot be raided at all.
apps.infoText.every_3_finished_jobs: Every 3 finished jobs offer a {0} (stats perk lists them, stats perk <id> takes one).
apps.infoText.every_world_has_about: Every world has {0}: about 900 work for the 40 companies, about 1,100 are civilians with mail at public providers. Everyone has a dossier: phone, email, social handle, role, city, clearance and sometimes a password leaked in an old breach. You start knowing none of it.
apps.infoText.each_person_shows_some: Each person shows some details to the world and keeps others private (fixed for the world). A public email, phone or handle appears as a link on their SleekPages profile and on their company's site: {0}, with a tick beside it from then on. Private details need OSINT.
apps.infoText.an_osint_sweep_on: An OSINT sweep on a link (bg osint) adds the company's staff to Dossiers as leads. The PEOPLE tab of a live link lists the staff of that company. {0} fills in a dossier; the better your People Finder, the more it finds:
apps.infoText.attacks_run_as_tasks: Attacks run as tasks while you are linked to a host of the person's company. Each button says what it needs and what it gets.
apps.infoText.a_voice_recording_for: a voice recording (for voice locks); leaves a call log
apps.infoText.the_same_recording_posing: the same recording, posing as their IT desk: no log, slower
apps.infoText.a_password_they_read: a password they read out: opens the strongest lock their clearance reaches on their company's hosts
apps.infoText.email_leaked_password_emai: email, leaked password + Email Login Tester, or a cracker at their clearance
apps.infoText.their_mail_every_host: their mail: every host of the company on your map, colleagues as leads, and (clearance 3+) a saved password that opens a lock
apps.infoText.a_fake_reset_mail: a fake reset mail. Three game hours later they take it or not (lower clearance = likelier): if taken the inbox is hacked and a lock opens
apps.infoText.their_inbox_buried_for: their inbox buried for a day. If they are the host's admin, links to their hosts trace 30% slower
apps.infoText.each_detail_of_a: Each detail of a person lives on the machines that would really keep it: name, sex, SSN and criminal record on government hosts; vital status on a health company's; social handle on a media company's; role, clearance, work email and employer on the person's own employer's. Alteration jobs only appear on hosts whose guard your rating can beat (MFA from rating 6, session-bound from 16, tokens from 30).
apps.infoText.the_dossiers_tab_of: The Dossiers tab of Bl@ckG@te lists everyone you have on file with a search box (name, company, role, email), a sort (recent, name, company, access, known) and a profile card with DETAILS, ACTIONS and JOBS tabs.
apps.infoText.your_gateway_is_built: Your gateway is built in three layers: a {0}, a {1} inside it and {2} on the board. The Device Manager shows the board with every slot (processors, booster, unlock chip, key reader, drive bays, internet, security). Click a slot to see what is in it, store or sell it, or fit a part from stock.
apps.infoText.the_top_shows_the: The top shows the machine's name and state and six metric tiles: thread slots, unlock speed, the SYS and STR drives with usage bars, internet and defence. Beside the board is an inspector with three tabs:
apps.infoText.the_spec_card_and: {0}: the spec card and what swapping changes.
apps.infoText.your_spare_parts_filtered: {0}: your spare parts, filtered by kind and sorted, with a FITS NOW badge or the reason a part cannot go in.
apps.infoText.build_a_second_machine: {0}: build a second machine while the live one keeps working.
apps.infoText.the_device_manager_sells: The Device Manager sells nothing: {0} opens the store, and what you order arrives in STOCK.
apps.infoText.a_case_takes_a: A case takes a board of its own size or smaller. Changing the case only goes up. Changing the board refunds 35% of the old board's price. Whatever the new case or board cannot hold goes to stock, and the CASE and BOARD tabs say so before you confirm.
apps.infoText.each_socket_gives_thread: {0}: each socket gives thread slots. All processors on a board must be the same model (32, 64, 128, 192 or 384 cores).
apps.infoText.booster_cards_x1_to: {0}: Booster Cards x1 to x4 (1.5x to 5x) speed up cracking, decrypting and voice synthesis.
apps.infoText.the_unlock_speed_chip: {0}: the Unlock Speed Chip decrypts and shakes hands 3x faster and a decryption on it takes no thread slot (ATX boards and up).
apps.infoText.the_security_key_reader: {0}: the Security Key Reader, needed for hardware-token locks (Micro-ATX and up).
apps.infoText.seven_kinds_of_drive: {0}: seven kinds of drive from the 32 GB M.2 SSD to the 12 TB HDD. SSDs run at full speed; HDDs slower. A drive needs both a board port and a case bay.
apps.infoText.download_speed_and_how: {0}: download speed and how many hops stay clean. Home fibre lines are followed 15% faster, business fibre 10% slower, the satellite dish 20% slower (but found from orbit after 120 seconds of activity).
apps.infoText.intruder_alarm_sensors_sel: {0}: Intruder Alarm Sensors, Self-Destruct Charge, Radio Jammer. A case with no security slot cannot fit them.
apps.infoText.bay_1_is_the: Bay 1 is the {0}: the apps live on it. Bay 2 and up are {1} and hold the downloads. The role follows the bay.
apps.infoText.a_hard_disk_as: A hard disk as the system drive runs every task at 60% speed.
apps.infoText.any_change_that_would: Any change that would leave the apps or files without room is refused, with the reason. To replace the SYS Drive buy its replacement first and fit it from stock in bay 1; the apps are copied over, which takes the machine offline for 30 minutes plus 1 minute per GB.
apps.infoText.the_machine_always_keeps: The machine always keeps one processor, a SYS Drive plus a STR Drive, and one network card. The Micro PC's soldered network card and eMMC cannot be removed.
apps.infoText.the_build_tab_makes: The BUILD tab makes a second machine {0} (buy them on eForest first). A step bar (CASE, BOARD, PARTS, ASSEMBLE, MIGRATE) shows progress. Picked items are reserved and return to stock if you remove them or SCRAP the build. ASSEMBLE starts one timer for the kit (a board 120 minutes, cards 20, processors and drives 30, security 25, one after the other). MIGRATE then lets you tick which live parts move across; the machine is offline for the new case's migration time plus 30 minutes and 1 minute per GB of apps. The IP, credits, tools and heat stay. The link must be closed first.
apps.infoText.parts_taken_out_go: Parts taken out go to stock. Selling from stock pays 30% to 55% of the price.
apps.infoText.open_it_in_internet: Open it in Internet XPlorer (eforest.nx, or {0} in the Device Manager). It sells cases, boards, processors, drives, cards and security parts.
apps.infoText.browse_by_search_sort: Browse by {0}, search, sort and add to the {1}.
apps.infoText.a_daily_deal_takes: A daily deal takes 25% off one item.
apps.infoText.cases_and_boards_double: Cases and boards double the minimum fee. Orders arrive in the Device Manager's stock. {0}: a card 20 minutes, a processor or drive 30, security 25, a board 120, a case its own migration time. Plan fittings between jobs, never during a link.
apps.infoText.the_app_store_sells: The App Store sells the tools you hack with. Cards are coloured by family (break-in, bypass, stealth, data, recon, social) and can be filtered {0}. A spec sheet shows an upgrade track (one step per version), one big {1} button and the RAM the tool needs while running.
apps.infoText.the_shop_only_sells: The shop only sells a tool once the game has a task that uses it, and a version is only sold if it does something the one below does not.
apps.infoText.every_tool_takes_room: Every tool takes room on the SYS Drive: its cpu cost times 6.5 GB for version 1, and each later version adds 1.3 times that again. An upgrade replaces the old version so only the difference has to fit. All tools at their top version come to 500 GB, so a 512 GB SYS Drive holds the whole catalogue.
apps.infoText.opens_password_locks_up: Opens password locks up to its version.
apps.infoText.hijacks_a_live_session: Hijacks a live session behind app MFA (v1) or session-bound MFA (v2).
apps.infoText.scrubs_proxies_up_to: Scrubs proxies up to PX of its version.
apps.infoText.gets_past_firewalls_up: Gets past firewalls up to FW of its version.
apps.infoText.blinds_monitors_up_to: Blinds monitors up to its version.
apps.infoText.drops_firewalls_and_proxie: Drops firewalls and proxies at once, loudly.
apps.infoText.decrypts_files_encrypted_u: Decrypts files encrypted up to its version.
apps.infoText.scrubs_only_your_own: Scrubs only your own log entries.
apps.infoText.wipes_all_the_logs: Wipes all the logs on a host.
apps.infoText.profile_finds_email_and: PROFILE finds email and role, then phone, handle, leaked password.
apps.infoText.opens_an_inbox_with: Opens an inbox with its owner's leaked password.
apps.infoText.records_voices_and_matches: Records voices and matches voice locks.
apps.infoText.spoofed_calls_phishing_spa: Spoofed calls, phishing, spam; phone taps need v2.
apps.infoText.maps_a_company_s: Maps a company's hidden hosts up to difficulty 6, 10, any.
apps.infoText.opens_a_locked_service: Opens a locked service with a stolen key: password locks, then app MFA, then session-bound MFA.
apps.infoText.moves_the_live_link: Moves the live link to another host of the same company, up to difficulty 6, 10, any.
apps.infoText.roots_the_host_and: Roots the host and opens every lock it reaches, but always raises the alert: the trace starts, jumps and runs twice as fast.
apps.infoText.hud_the_target_s: HUD: the target's guards, difficulty and window in the link panel.
apps.infoText.hud_draws_your_route: HUD: draws your route hop by hop.
apps.infoText.hud_opens_the_company: HUD: opens the Company Map of a company's segments.
apps.infoText.a_target_needs_a: A target needs a tool at least as strong as its own rating for each guard. The HUD programs only add information: none of them is needed to use a bypass.
apps.infoText.your_gateway_s_drive: Your gateway's drive as a file explorer, with a C: and a D: card showing the SYS and STR drives and their usage bars.
apps.infoText.the_installed_software_whi: {0}: the installed software, which takes room on C:.
apps.infoText.the_files_you_copied: {0}: the files you copied from hosts, on D:. Delete one to free room (the Command Prompt has storage delete).
apps.infoText.your_own_log_one: {0}: your own log, one file a day named yymmdd.log (for example 270312.log) holding everything that happened that day. Pick one and press {1}, or double-click it.
apps.infoText.the_logs_of_a: The logs of a machine you are linked to are separate, one entry each, on the Live Link.
apps.infoText.your_balance_and_the: {0}: your balance and the ledger of every transaction.
apps.infoText.move_credits_in_and: {0}: move credits in and out. Pays 0.4% a day, up to 50,000 cr.
apps.infoText.one_loan_at_a: {0}: one loan at a time. The limit grows with your rating, interest is 2% a day and it is due in 7 days. A missed date empties your balance and costs rating and heat.
apps.infoText.three_coins_to_trade: {0}: three coins to trade: STBL (low risk), BLUE (mid) and GHST (high). Each trade costs 1%.
apps.infoText.the_game_is_tuned: The game is tuned so the whole catalogue, a top-end rig and the running costs come to about what a 15-hour run earns. Every game day you pay 60 cr plus 2% of what the rig is worth. What the balance cannot cover waits as {0} and is taken from the next credits that come in.
apps.infoText.messages_from_the_broker: {0}: messages from the broker, clients and contacts. Job offers have ACCEPT, DECLINE and SHOW TARGET buttons, and an OPEN LINK button to the deal page. {1} clears the unread count. A welcome mail waits at the start of a run.
apps.infoText.the_newswire_including_sto: {0}: the newswire, including stories about the work you have done.
apps.infoText.your_handle_rank_and: {0}: your handle, rank and rating; a record of missions complete and failed, files extracted, log sets wiped, clean escapes and ghost runs; money earned, balance, heat and story act; and a bar for each rival operator's rating.
apps.infoText.every_45_seconds_and: {0}: {1}, {2}, {3} every 45 seconds, {4} and the {5}; plus SAVE NOW and SAVE + QUIT.
apps.infoText.your_rating_rises_as: Your rating rises as you finish jobs, up to 150, and gives you a rank. Rivals earn rating too: the bars show where you stand.
apps.infoText.notes_kept_with_your: Notes kept with your run. Up to {0} as tabs: {1} makes an UNTITLED one and {2} pressed twice deletes it. It has line numbers, word wrap, scroll bars and a caret you move with the arrow keys.
apps.infoText.use_it_for_passwords: Use it for passwords you found, IP addresses, who works where and the plan for a job. A log opened from My Computer lands here.
apps.infoText.open_it_from_the: Open it from the Start menu or with the {0} key. Commands take the form <app> <action> [what], for example mail read new or ct accept 12. A command that changes the game does exactly what the matching button does, with the same costs, checks and messages.
apps.infoText.after_a_list_code: After a list, #n picks its n-th row (ct list, then ct accept #2). Hosts can also be named by IP or name, contracts by id, files by name.
apps.infoText.put_text_with_spaces: Put text with spaces in quotes: bg alter "Ana Diaz" status deceased.
apps.infoText.runs_the_line_completes: {0} runs the line, {1} completes it, {2} / {3} recall earlier lines, {4} clears it and the mouse wheel scrolls back.
apps.infoText.commands_that_take_a: Commands that take a part out of your machine or wipe the notepad need --yes.
apps.infoText.typing_an_app_s: Typing an app's name alone lists its commands.

apps.infoText.move_credits_to_or: Move credits to or from savings
apps.infoText.open_a_page_in: Open a page in Internet XPlorer / search DSNET
apps.infoText.read_the_answer_take: Read the answer / take a counter-offer
apps.infoText.everyone_on_file_the: Everyone on file, the company's staff, one dossier
apps.infoText.a_pocket_calculator_click: A pocket calculator. Click the keys, or type: digits, + - * / %, ., {0} or = to work it out, {1} to delete and C to clear. The +/- key flips the sign.
apps.infoText.in_the_command_prompt: In the Command Prompt, calc eval 12*(3+4) does a sum too, and also understands ^ and brackets.
apps.infoText.click_the_top_left: Click the {0} (top left) to open {1}. Using it does {2} mark your run as cheated. Three tabs: {3}, {4} and {5}, with a status line.
apps.infoText.set_your_money_rating: Set your money, rating (0 to 150) and heat (it stops at 99, because a raid starts at 100).
apps.infoText.pause_and_set_the: Pause, and set the clock speed (1x, 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x).
apps.infoText.build_a_job_to: {0}: build a job to order, choosing its kind, target, objective, payout, deadline, client and brief. The kinds use the market's names with a line explaining the one picked.
apps.infoText.in_the_command_prompt_2: In the Command Prompt: cheat money <n>, cheat heat <0-99>, cheat rating <n>, cheat speed <1|2|4|8|16>, cheat reveal, cheat tools, cheat gateway, cheat mission, cheat tutorial.
apps.infoText.your_rating_rises_as_2: Your rating rises as you finish jobs, up to 150. It unlocks harder, better paid work.
apps.infoText.the_world_is_built: The world is built to match: locks run 1 to 3, voice locks are 1, the firewall, monitor and proxy each go to 5 and encryption to 7. Difficulty is the three guards added (up to 15). The job board only offers guards your unlocked tool versions can beat (none below rating 6), and pay grows with both the target and your rating.
apps.infoText.a_job_done_with: {0} A job done with logs left behind still raises heat. Wipe or scrub before you disconnect.
apps.infoText.plan_the_route_equip: {0} Plan the route, equip the tools and prepare dossiers first, then link, work and leave.
apps.infoText.press_space_while_you: {0} Press Space while you think. The clock only runs when you let it.
apps.infoText.a_good_long_route: {0} A good long route is worth reusing.
apps.infoText.a_full_str_drive: {0} A full STR drive stops a copy, and a full SYS drive stops a tool upgrade.
apps.infoText.order_parts_on_eforest: {0} Order parts on eForest and fit them when no link is open.
apps.infoText.a_refused_ask_costs: {0} A refused ask costs nothing, but an insulting one pulls the listing.
apps.infoText.at_recon_70_stop: {0} At RECON (70) stop adding noise, cool down, or use the van.
apps.infoText.it_is_the_only: {0} It is the only place that lists a host's guards, difficulty and window before you commit.
apps.infoText.a_good_profile_turns: {0} A good profile turns a hard lock into a phone call.
apps.infoText.a_bigger_rig_costs: {0} A bigger rig costs more each day: do not outgrow your income.
apps.infoText.a_button_is_greyed: A button is greyed: hover it, the tooltip (or the Command Prompt) says what is missing.
apps.infoText.a_task_is_waiting: A task is WAITING: all your thread slots are busy.
apps.infoText.a_copy_will_not: A copy will not start: there is no room on a STR drive, or the file needs decrypting first.
apps.infoText.a_lock_will_not: A lock will not open: its version is higher than your tool's, or it sits behind MFA and needs the Two-Step Login Bypass.
apps.infoText.in_the_windows_app: In the Windows app everything for your Windows account lives in Documents\Games\Blackgate.
apps.infoText.the_installed_game_replace: The installed game. Replaced by each new build.
apps.infoText.one_save_per_profile: One save per profile (four at most): the whole world, your dossiers and your run.
apps.infoText.the_machines_that_operator: The machines that operator has connected to.
apps.infoText.your_copy_of_the: Your copy of the game's content files. Edit these to mod the world.
apps.infoText.warnings_for_example_about: Warnings, for example about content files that differ from the game's.
apps.infoText.the_launcher_blackgate_exe: {0} The launcher (blackgate.exe) checks GitHub for a new build whenever it starts and installs it first. An update only replaces app\; your saves and edited content files are never touched. A content file you never edited is refreshed from the new build; one you edited is kept and a warning is written to blackgate.log (delete your copy to take the new one).
apps.infoText.the_game_runs_from: {0} the game runs from the dev server and saves in the browser's local storage.
apps.infoText.the_start_menu_s: {0} The Start menu's Log off saves and returns to the login screen, where Turn off shows "Press Alt + F4 to exit or any key to reboot".
